Namespace ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper

Classes

Paths64PooledBuffer

Maintains a reusable Clipper2Lib.Paths64 buffer backed by a pool of Clipper2Lib.Path64 instances.

ShapeClipper2D

Provides shared Clipper-backed 2D geometry utilities and configuration for path extraction, clipping, offsetting, shape creation, simplification, winding analysis, and hole filtering.

ShapeClipper64

Provides reusable helpers for performing boolean clipping operations on Clipper Clipper2Lib.Path64 and Clipper2Lib.Paths64 geometry, as well as engine polygon data represented by Vector2 lists.

ShapeClipperConversion2D

Provides Clipper/world-space conversion helpers for 2D paths, polygons, rectangles, points, and related enums.

ShapeClipperDrawing2D

Provides immediate-style drawing helpers for polygons and polylines backed by ShapeClipper triangulation.

ShapeClipperOffset

Wraps a Clipper2Lib.ClipperOffset instance to offset polygons and polylines using the engine's world-space coordinate conventions.

ShapeClipperTriangulation2D

Provides Clipper-backed triangulation helpers for polygons, polygon outlines, and polyline strokes in 2D.

TriMesh

Represents a mutable triangle mesh stored as a flat vertex buffer.

TriMeshPool

Provides a simple reusable pool of TriMesh instances to reduce allocations during repeated triangulation work.

Enums

ShapeClipperClipType

Specifies the boolean clipping operation to apply when combining shapes.

ShapeClipperEndType

The ShapeClipperEndType enumerator controls how the ends of paths are handled when performing offset (inflating/shrinking) operations. This enumeration is only required for offset operations and is not used for polygon clipping.

ShapeClipperFillRule

Filling rules determine which sub-regions of complex polygons are considered "inside". Complex polygons are defined by one or more closed contours; only portions of these contours may contribute to filled regions, so a filling rule is required to decide which sub-regions are treated as inside when performing clipping operations.

ShapeClipperJoinType

Specifies how convex angled joins are handled when offsetting (inflating/shrinking) paths. This enumeration is only required for offset operations (e.g. ClipperOffset) and is not used for polygon clipping operations.
